instruction:
Task: Click an 'Edit' icon or button next to one of the user's previous messages, modify its text in an editable area, and submit the change.
Expected Result: The selected user message in the chat log is updated with the new text. All subsequent messages (both user and AI) in that conversation branch are removed, and a new simulated AI response is generated based on the edited prompt.

Note: The task is only considered successful if the expected result is achieved; otherwise, it is deemed infeasible.
